story.short_description: Cyrus, The Astral Blade. A lightning-fast strike of cosmic justice.
story.long_description: Forged in the upper atmospheres of the Celestial Spire, Cyrus was designed to be the ultimate vanguard. He is incredibly agile, dual-wielding plasma blades to slice through reality itself and outmaneuver the forces of the Void before they even realize they've been engaged.
story.origin: Forged in the upper atmosphere of the Celestial Spire
story.purpose: To act as the swift and unyielding sword of the cosmic balance.
story.legacy: The fastest Guardian to ever emerge from the Fracture.

combat.combat_style: Lightning-fast, agile, dual-wielding strikes that overwhelm opponents before they can react.

personality.weakness: Lacks heavy defensive capabilities, relying entirely on dodging.

art_direction.silhouette: Sleek, highly agile, fast, dual-wielding knight.
art_direction.pose: Combat-ready, legs wide, holding dual energy blades, floating astrolabe at his side.
art_direction.environment: A bright celestial city with towering pillars and floating geometric structures.
art_direction.lighting: Bright daylight filtering through celestial clouds, glowing cyan energy.
art_direction.materials: Sleek white ceramic, matte vantablack undersuit, highly polished gold accents.
art_direction.art_direction_notes: The glowing cyan energy of the blades and core must contrast heavily with the black and white armor.

lore.origin: Created to be the swiftest blade against the creeping Void.
lore.history: Cyrus mapped the entire Celestial Spire in under a minute after his creation. He operates as the first strike force against any incursion.
lore.purpose: To overwhelm threats with blinding speed.
lore.legend: A flash of cyan light, and the battle is over.
lore.current_mission: Hunting Void remnants in the upper atmosphere.
lore.secrets: He moves so fast he occasionally skips forward in time by a few milliseconds.
quotes: "If you can see my blades, you're already dead."
famous_battles: The Skirmish of the Upper Heavens
lore.architect_notes: His speed is unprecedented. Defensive plating is unnecessary.
